text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The fierce battle of the Grand Masters left a deep impression on all who watched, coming to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And today as well, inside the simulator—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: All right, next, tell me what your weapon is!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I'm not good under pressure... but Trainer worried through it together with me—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: So, a runaway lead so massive you won't even feel the pressure! I like it, let's hone that skill!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I'm scared of running along the inner rail, but going wide puts me at a disadvantage, so my Trainer and I have been struggling with it...

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
"You need to become stronger.
However, what needs strengthening is your heart."

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Not merely overcoming, but carving out a new path.
That isn't running away—it's moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
You've worked so hard to get here.
Tomorrow is the race at last, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: My Trainer and I talked about deciding my future path based on the result here, but... um...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
...Standing at a crossroads brings anxiety, doesn't it?
After all, it is the threshold to the unknown.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
“Still, your Trainer is
without a doubt your greatest ally... You can put your mind at ease.”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much!
Before I worry, I'm going to run this race with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: "More and more Trainers and Umamusume are making use of VR these days, haven't they?"

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Many were likely inspired
by the battles at the recent Grand Masters.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: After all, the Umamusume who ran upon that stage have received something beyond mere knowledge from the Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer Kashimoto!
I'm all set for training!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fully prepared too.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Have you already decided on today's menu
with the Three Goddesses?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Yes, we share opinions and decide together. All so that you girls can run your absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then I'm off.
I'm counting on you today as well!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, all of them are brimming with spirit.
I can tell they're just itching to run!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone's here!
Run with everything you've got today, and believe in yourself!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
First, build up your foundational muscle strength.
And polish your confidence along the way!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching over you at all times,
so don't look back—just look forward and run~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Three Goddesses, said to be the ancestors of Umamusume, support today's running Umamusume and Trainers through the history of those who came before them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Will the hoofprints left behind by me and <chrname>
eventually be passed down to other Umamusume as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I silently cheered <chrname> on, urging her to run with all her might right now so she could be just that.
